scope: Adds a research-only strict-OOF long economic-recall router and expands the training-only path-label materialiser for the replacement A-E auxiliary-target contract. No live, exchange, consensus, MC1, admission, portfolio, or execution artifact is modified.

commands: Focused _materialize_month test on 256 April-2025 resolved paths: all A-E fields present, invalid rows null, finite ratio invariants passed

Strict-OOF 2026-07 A-group smoke artifact strict_r3_economic_recall_router_ae_smoke_20260825_v3_groupa: 123,225 held target-free rows, zero copied policy/path/outcome/label-availability fields, 239,886 strict-resolved train rows, reserve starts 2026-06-03

Strict-OOF complete A-E 2026-07 smoke artifact strict_r3_economic_recall_router_ae_smoke_20260825_v5: 238,592 strict-resolved train rows, 123,225 target-free held rows, 17 heads, and a score-schema whitelist audit with zero undeclared columns

Timestamp-level group-gate validation strict_r3_economic_recall_router_ae_smoke_20260825_v5_groupgate_timestamp_v4: 741 decision timestamps, all ER/recall/EV selection quantities aggregated equally by timestamp; full suite did not beat primary-only, so leave-one-group-out arms were correctly not inspected

Static timestamp-contract validation: router training weights remain one total loss weight per exact timestamp; router and post-score gate now emit timestamp receipts, use timestamp means for ER/recall/EV, and label pooled trade totals disclosure-only

Base-control parity receipt strict_r3_router_p3p4_vs_b0_timestamp_20260825_v1: 2,196 exact decision timestamps and identical held candidate identities; P3/P4 exceed B0 in timestamp ER50, winner recall, and selected-policy EV at 30/40/50% routes

Bounded timestamp-only HPO selection strict_r3_economic_recall_router_ae_hpo_timestamp_selection_20260825_v1: selector uses 0.25*mean timestamp ER50@30 + 0.35*@40 + 0.40*@50; candidate/trade pooled totals are prohibited. P3 H2 tail ranks first (0.7082243) and P4 H2 tail second (0.7080030)

HPO winner group gates: P3 H2 primary-only 0.7082243 vs complete A-E 0.6872022; P4 H2 primary-only 0.7080030 vs complete A-E 0.6874750. Complete A-E loses both gates, so no group-removal arms were inspected as predeclared.
validation.not_run_reason: No live or exchange test is applicable: this change is research-only and explicitly excludes live pipeline mutation.
